pii_field_classification_policy_enforced.title: PII Field Classification Policy Enforced
pii_field_classification_policy_enforced.description: Whether a formal, enforced data classification policy exists that requires all PII and financial fields in the database to be tagged with a sensitivity tier (e.g., public, internal, confidential, restricted).

unclassified_pii_field_count.title: Unclassified PII Field Count
unclassified_pii_field_count.description: The number of database fields known or suspected to contain PII or financial data that currently lack an assigned sensitivity classification label.

misclassified_pii_field_count.title: Misclassified PII Field Count
misclassified_pii_field_count.description: The number of database fields containing PII or financial data that are assigned an incorrect (too-low) sensitivity classification tier, causing insufficient handling controls to be applied.

retention_policy_defined.title: Retention Policy Formally Defined
retention_policy_defined.description: Indicates whether a formal, documented data retention policy exists that specifies legally mandated or organization-defined retention periods for PII and financial records.

automated_purge_enforcement_enabled.title: Automated Purge/Archival Enforcement Enabled
automated_purge_enforcement_enabled.description: Indicates whether an automated mechanism (scheduled jobs, TTL policies, data lifecycle management tools) exists and is active to purge or archive records according to defined retention periods.

oldest_unreviewed_record_age_days.title: Age of Oldest Unreviewed PII/Financial Record (Days)
oldest_unreviewed_record_age_days.description: The age in days of the oldest PII or financial record in the database that has not been reviewed, purged, or confirmed as within an active retention window.

max_policy_retention_days.title: Maximum Permitted Retention Period (Days)
max_policy_retention_days.description: The maximum number of days PII or financial records may be retained per the applicable legal or policy requirements (the strictest applicable retention limit).

environment_type.title: Environment Type
environment_type.description: The classification of the environment where the database is deployed (e.g., production, development, test, staging, analytics).

pii_data_present.title: PII or Financial Data Present in Database
pii_data_present.description: Indicates whether the database contains real (unmasked) personally identifiable information or financial data records sourced from production. Also confirms applicability of retention and disposal controls.

masking_or_anonymization_applied.title: Masking or Anonymization Applied
masking_or_anonymization_applied.description: Indicates whether data masking, anonymization, or pseudonymization controls are enforced on PII and financial fields before or during data copy to this environment.

sensitive_fields_with_encryption.title: Sensitive Field Encryption Coverage
sensitive_fields_with_encryption.description: Indicates whether high-sensitivity fields (SSNs, payment card numbers, account credentials) have field-level or column-level encryption applied in the database schema.

unencrypted_sensitive_field_types.title: Unencrypted Sensitive Field Types
unencrypted_sensitive_field_types.description: List of sensitive field categories stored in plaintext without field-level encryption (e.g., 'ssn', 'payment_card', 'account_credential', 'bank_account', 'tax_id').

pii_financial_columns_with_broad_read_ac.title: PII/Financial Columns With Broad Read Access
pii_financial_columns_with_broad_read_ac.description: List of PII or financial column identifiers (e.g., table.column) that are readable by roles or service accounts beyond those with documented operational need.

column_level_access_control_enforced.title: Column-Level Access Control Enforced
column_level_access_control_enforced.description: Whether the database enforces column-level (or view/policy-based) access controls that restrict PII and financial field visibility to only authorized roles.

overprivileged_role_count.title: Overprivileged Role Count
overprivileged_role_count.description: Number of distinct database roles or service accounts that have read access to PII or financial columns without a documented operational justification.

data_masking_applied_to_sensitive_column.title: Data Masking Applied to Sensitive Columns
data_masking_applied_to_sensitive_column.description: Whether dynamic data masking or equivalent redaction is applied to PII and financial columns for roles that do not require full plaintext access.

replication_target_jurisdictions.title: Replication Target Jurisdictions
replication_target_jurisdictions.description: List of country or region codes where database data is replicated, backed up, or transferred (e.g., ['US', 'IN', 'CN']).

adequacy_decision_verified.title: Adequacy Decision Verified
adequacy_decision_verified.description: Whether all replication/transfer target jurisdictions have been verified to have an EU adequacy decision or equivalent legal basis (e.g., SCCs, BCRs) documented and enforced.

transfer_mechanism_type.title: Transfer Mechanism Type
transfer_mechanism_type.description: The legal transfer mechanism documented for cross-border data transfers.

cryptographic_erasure_enforced.title: Cryptographic Erasure Enforced on Deletion
cryptographic_erasure_enforced.description: Whether the data disposal process enforces cryptographic erasure (key destruction for encrypted data) or verified overwrite for PII and financial records upon deletion or decommissioning.

backup_purge_verified.title: Backup Sets Verified Purged After Record Deletion
backup_purge_verified.description: Whether backup retention policies require and verify that deleted PII/financial records are also purged or rendered unrecoverable in all backup sets within the defined retention window.

disposal_verification_method.title: Disposal Verification Method
disposal_verification_method.description: The method used to verify that data has been successfully and completely disposed of after deletion or decommissioning.

data_lineage_tracking_enabled.title: Data Lineage Tracking Enabled
data_lineage_tracking_enabled.description: Whether an authoritative system tracks the origin, transformation history, and movement of PII and financial data through the database and upstream/downstream systems.

classification_audit_trail_present.title: Classification Audit Trail Present
classification_audit_trail_present.description: Whether each PII or financial data element has an associated audit record capturing what classification label was applied, when it was applied, and by which process or user.

access_history_logged_for_sensitive_data.title: Access History Logged for Sensitive Data
access_history_logged_for_sensitive_data.description: Whether read and write access to PII and financial data fields is logged with sufficient detail (user identity, timestamp, query or operation) to reconstruct who accessed what data and when.
